newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures finish sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures finish sharply higher.

text.p: April 14 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures finished sharply higher amid brisk dealer buying in the afternoon. Traders said shortcovering and intraday technicals after huge slide Friday started the rally. Traders await March CPI at 0730 CDT/1230 GMT on Tuesday. Core rate forecast up 0.3 percent, up 0.2 percent overall.
